chatCards.name: Show party loot in chat
chatCards.hint: Show a chat card whenever someone puts items or coins into the party loot, takes them out, or spends from it. This only changes what you see: every GM and player chooses for themselves.

chat.depositCoins: {character} put coins into the party loot:
chat.withdrawCoins: {character} took coins from the party loot:
chat.spendCoins: {character} spent coins from the party loot on {reason}:

gm.depositItem: Gamemaster moved {item} from {character} into the party loot.
gm.addItem: Gamemaster added {item} to the party loot.
gm.withdrawItem: Gamemaster handed {item} to {character} from the party loot.
gm.depositCoins: Gamemaster moved coins from {character} into the party loot:
gm.withdrawCoins: Gamemaster handed coins to {character} from the party loot:
gm.spendCoins: Gamemaster spent coins from the party loot on {reason}:
gm.addCoins: Gamemaster added coins to the party loot:
gm.removeCoins: Gamemaster removed coins from the party loot:
gm.clearLog: Gamemaster cleared the spending ledger ({count} entries).
